quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: When driving faster than 30 mph, what is the minimum following distance you should keep?
questions.explanation: Keep at least four seconds of distance between your vehicle and others when driving faster than 30 mph in normal conditions. This gives you more time to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: When parallel parking, your vehicle should be within how many inches of the curb?
questions.explanation: Your wheels should be within 18 inches of the curb when parallel parking. Only park in places where you won't block traffic and where other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: You reach an intersection with a flashing red light. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then proceed when traffic allows.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then proceed when traffic allows.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a full stop. After stopping, proceed through the intersection when it is safe.

questions.question: What do round signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn you of an upcoming railroad crossing. Drive slowly and carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: Stopping completely, letting cross traffic and pedestrians pass, then proceeding when clear describes which light?
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Are placed wherever there is immediate danger.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
Warn drivers about school zones ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with white and black markings. They tell drivers what they must or must not do, such as speed limits or turning restrictions.

questions.question: What best keeps you and others safe when backing up your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
Turn up the radio to alert people around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Backing up is dangerous because you cannot see well behind your vehicle. Before entering your vehicle to back up, walk to the rear to check for children and small objects.

questions.question: What is the speed limit on a highway unless otherwise posted?
questions.explanation: The default speed limit on numbered highways outside urban areas is 70 miles per hour. Always follow posted speed limit signs if they show a different speed.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?
questions.explanation: When parking on a downhill slope, turn your wheels toward the curb. If your vehicle rolls, it will roll away from traffic toward the side of the road.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." When you see it, slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: If a pedestrian hybrid beacon signal lights are black, it means:

options.text: Drivers should slow down and prepare to stop.
Drivers should come to a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Black lights on a pedestrian hybrid beacon mean you can go. Drive through the crosswalk carefully and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow X on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: The signal is about to change to a red X.
The signal is about to change to a green arrow.
Drivers may drive normally in this lane.
Drivers may drive slowly in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The signal is about to change to a red X.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow X warns you to leave the lane. The signal will soon turn red, closing that lane. Get out of the lane right away.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be prepared to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals so you will never encounter this situation.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down and watch for trains from both directions. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance. Wait until the train passes before crossing.

questions.question: To check your blind spot when changing lanes to the left, glance:
questions.explanation: Look over the shoulder on the side you want to move toward. This helps you see your blind spot.

questions.question: When visibility is poor, your first action should be:
questions.explanation: Slow down first when you cannot see well. This is the most important thing to do in bad visibility.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT affect your stopping distance?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. It changes based on speed and road conditions. Steering ability does not affect how far it takes to stop.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black text. They control traffic and must be followed by all drivers.

questions.question: When driving to an unfamiliar area, you should:

options.text: Depend on road signs to find your way.
Know only generally where your destination is.
Always choose the most direct route.

questions.explanation: Plan your route before you drive. Check a map and know where you are going. Do not start driving without knowing your destination.

questions.question: Roads become very slippery:

options.text: When it has been raining for an hour or more.
For the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
Right after the rain has stopped.

questions.correctAnswerText: For the first 10 to 15 minutes of a rainstorm.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. Rain brings oil from the pavement to the surface, making it slick. This is worse in hot weather.

questions.question: What does a flag on the back of a bicycle mean?
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a bicycle with a flag. The flag means the rider may not be able to hear. Be careful around bicycles.

questions.question: When driving under 30 mph, keep a minimum following distance of:
questions.explanation: Keep more distance between your car and others so you have time to react. Use a two-second gap when driving under 30 mph in normal conditions.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers:

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on a road to your left and you arrive at an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic light is a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield when you enter a street from an alley, driveway, or garage. You must also yield to pedestrians on a crossing sidewalk.

questions.question: If a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you:

options.text: Can still turn, but you must let oncoming traffic go first.
Cannot turn anymore and must go straight.
Still have the right to turn.
No longer need to turn in the arrow's direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can still turn, but you must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow becomes solid green, you can still turn that way. But first, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass.

questions.question: To check your blind spots before changing lanes:

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Always turn your head to look over your shoulder before you change lanes. This checks your blind spots.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles often cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection. The light is green but traffic is heavy. You should:

options.text: Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Turn because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with oncoming traffic, wait for it to pass. If the light is green, you can enter the intersection to prepare for your left turn if no car ahead of you is turning left.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a reversible lane control signal mean?

options.text: The signal will soon change to a red X.
Do not drive in this lane.
Use this lane only to turn left.
You can drive normally in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can drive normally in this lane.
questions.explanation: Reversible lane signals show which lanes are open or closed as traffic direction changes. A green arrow means you can drive normally in that lane.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and turn your wheel away from the curb. If the car rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: At an intersection with no stop line or crosswalk markings, a driver must:

options.text: Slow down to check that crossing traffic is clear.
Stop where they can see 200 feet in each direction, even if they enter the other roadway.
Stop where they can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the other roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop where they can clearly see approaching traffic before entering the other roadway.
questions.explanation: With no stop line or crosswalk, stop at the point closest to the other road where you can see traffic coming. Do not enter the other road just to see better.
